sequence: unlabeled tests -> source/config freeze -> GROUP_A551 inference seal -> separate GROUP_A scoring -> frozen regression1082 seal -> separate regression scoring -> all-frame rendering and integrity
primary: public tip<=10 original px and observed-only path coverage/precision>=.8 at10px; fixed visible denominator
harmful: Any per-frame newly GT-excluded tip, lost good candidate pool, lost actual tip/joint success, or new public>100/>500 error in GROUP_A or exposed regression makes that mode GEOMETRY_HARMFUL. Validation does not redesign parameters.
geometry_benefit: Absent harmful events: GROUP_A actual hit10 AND joint increase; public coverage>=A; area<=.75*A; fewer nodes and nonincreasing unvisited path-budget routes. Only GEOMETRY_BENEFIT gives research GO.
compute_only: Absent harm/accuracy benefit: area<=.75*A and median cached-path inference<=.85*A; other costs separate. Otherwise UNRESOLVED.
default_decision: C predeclared; B always separately reported, never selected per group
prelabel_smoke: GROUP_A middle ordinal276, selected without labels
cache_policy: Full original SHA and point source verification; shared frozen evidence cache; A/B/C genuinely re-run inference
scope_note: Previous multi-group reports are required background, not new excluded-group experimental inputs
